version.changelog:
- Initial release of the GLM Master Skill (documentation-only, guide purpose).
- Provides a curated catalog of official GLM skills with links and descriptions.
- Lists recommended installation methods, including Clawhub and direct GitHub source.
- Shares API key setup instructions and resource links.
- No scripts or subprocess execution—purely navigation and explanation for safer distribution.

llm.summary: This is a documentation-only master skill that lists GLM skills and install instructions; its declared metadata matches its behavior, with only minor notes about a referenced API key.

dimensions.detail: The skill claims to be documentation-only and contains only links, guidance, and example install commands. It does not request binaries, env vars, or install steps itself, which is consistent with the stated purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions are limited to recommending installs (npx clawhub, git clone) and pointing to other skills' SKILL.md files. The doc mentions the ZHIPU_API_KEY used by downstream GLM skills; although the master skill doesn't require that secret, callers should be aware downstream skills will. The skill does not instruct the agent to execute local commands itself.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec or bundled code is present (instruction-only). Example install methods reference external tooling (npx, git clone) but those are user-visible commands and not executed by the skill itself.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no required environment variables, but the documentation instructs users to set ZHIPU_API_KEY for many GLM skills. This is reasonable for a catalog, but the master skill could more explicitly declare that downstream components will request that credential.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill does not request persistent presence or special privileges (always=false). It does not modify other skills or system configuration and contains no code that would persist or run autonomously.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is a read-only guide that points at GLM-related skills and shows example install commands. It does not itself run code or request credentials, but be aware: (1) following the shown npx or git clone commands will run code from external sources—verify the referenced GitHub repos and their SKILL.md before installing; (2) many downstream GLM skills require ZHIPU_API_KEY (a sensitive API key) — only provide that key to trusted packages and store it securely; (3) when an agent recommends installing a skill, treat that as a suggestion and confirm any commands before letting them run on your machine.
